title: Shape-preserving casts hide the K axis from MMA carry analysis
target: sm_103a; shared query also exercised on sm_100a
executor_revision: none; static probes and CPU source execution only

evidence.cases: All eight fib_gemm tasks have a direct FP16 probe and an explicit FP16-to-FP32 plus tf32-dot probe. The former is correctly refused by TARGET_INSTRUCTION_UNSUPPORTED. The latter is refused by BUFFER_ESCAPES_LOOP for acc, although both loads walk the contraction K axis.

observation: Schedule._staged_axis_filled_by only looks for an access map on the immediate producer. A cast has no access map, so inserting shape-preserving casts between loads and MMA makes mma_accumulates_over return false. Both the register-lifetime verifier and emitter consume that query. Removing the lifetime guard alone would be wrong: the emitter would also lose the carry. Eight task probes share this same cause; they are not eight independent performance observations.
proposed_change: Trace a unique, shape-preserving cast chain back to its producer before querying the existing access map. Refuse to prove cyclic, ambiguous or shape-changing chains. Preserve the output-axis distinction. Check CPU execution of the emitted K-loop with tails and cast chains; retain all target admission gates and Corpus expectations. The bounded nested backend gate remains a separate capability limit.
principles: P1/P3: no new syntax or accumulate flag. P2/P8: explicit casts retain their semantics and only preserve coordinates. P4/P5/P7: construction and dtype checks stay with their owners, while the shared provenance query updates verifier and emitter together. P6: regression tests and unchanged Corpus Gate.

verified_by.kind: CPU contracts, emitted-source execution and replay of original static probes
verified_by.outcome: All eight explicit FP16-to-FP32 tf32-dot candidates now lower; all eight direct FP16-dot candidates still refuse TARGET_INSTRUCTION_UNSUPPORTED. CPU emitted-source tests sum every K tile including tails and nonidentity cast chains; output-axis, cyclic, shape-changing and ambiguous producer checks remain bounded.
verified_by.scope: Software verification only. No GPU correctness, tensor-core qualification or performance claim.

device_verification.outcome: All eight original explicit-cast TF32 GEMM probes passed their five existing oracle distributions on B300. Same fixed M=1 shapes; input preservation checked.
device_verification.scope: Development GPU correctness, not tensor-core qualification, external-performance parity, full-shape coverage or pass promotion.
